# The Best Chicken Kabab Corner

> Local restaurant in Best Colony, Goregaon West (Mumbai, India) serving authentic tandoori and kabab specialties: chicken tikka, seekh kabab, tandoori chicken, fish and prawns tikka, and paneer tikka. Open 5:00 PM – 12:00 AM. Orders are placed online through the website and sent to the restaurant on WhatsApp.

Key facts:

- Location: Best Colony, Goregaon West, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Timings: 5:00 PM – 12:00 AM
- Phone: +91 99878 34243, +91 80970 05775
- WhatsApp orders: +91 99878 34243
- Cuisine: Indian, tandoori, kebabs
- Ordering: choose Half or Full portions on the website, add to cart, then send the order on WhatsApp with name, mobile number and address. No online payment; payment and any delivery charges are confirmed on WhatsApp.
- All prices are in Indian Rupees (₹).

- [Home](https://www.example.com/): Restaurant overview, menu, online ordering and contact details on a single page
